source.title: Municipal Fisheries Situationer La Union: 2024
source.accessStatus: Official PSA Region I landing page and linked five-page PDF text reviewed through web access on 2026-11-19. No local PDF copy or full graphics were retained.
source.reuseStatus: The PSA Terms of Use classify statistical tables/datasets and documents on the site as open data under CC BY, and the linked license is CC BY 4.0. No contrary notice was identified in the reviewed PDF. Attribution, a link to the terms, change indication, and technical notes are required.

scope.collectionContext: The release says municipal fisheries data were gathered from Philippine Fisheries Development Authority records, LGU-managed landing centers, and traditional landing centers. Its technical notes describe quarterly municipal landing-center surveys and an inland survey based on sampled fishing households and monthly catch. The release does not identify which reporting channel supplied each displayed category.
scope.inlandDefinition: The technical notes define inland municipal fishing across inland waters including lakes, rivers, dams and marshes; no particular waterbody is named for the reported province-level catch.
scope.spatialResolution: Provincial annual production only. No named waterbody, landing center, municipality, station, fishing ground, coordinates or source-to-locality allocation is linked to the displayed catch labels.
scope.taxonomicResolution: The release gives English and local/common catch labels without scientific names, specimen identifiers, taxonomic methods or species-level crosswalks. Broad labels such as Mullet and Freshwater Goby remain unresolved; mollusks and crabs are included in catch categories but are not fish.

reportedProduction.roundingNote: The displayed marine and inland quantities sum to 3,699.49 metric tonnes, while the release reports 3,699.50 total; retain the source values and treat the 0.01 difference as rounding.

decision.use: Official provincial catch-production context to prioritize separate La Union marine and inland site-level searches. Preserve all source labels verbatim and keep production records separate from biodiversity occurrences.

limitations: The release reports provincial production and catch labels, not a species checklist, ecological survey, or population estimate.
No river, lake, dam, marsh, estuary, landing center, municipality, fishing ground, sample household, station or coordinate is linked to a reported inland category.
No scientific names or specimen-level taxonomic evidence are provided; Mullet and Freshwater Goby are broad labels, and several leading categories are mollusks or crustaceans rather than fish.
Production volume does not establish current presence, local abundance, catchability, diet, seasonality, legal access, safety, or geometry.

PSA Terms of Use classify statistical tables/datasets and documents on the site as CC BY, and link CC BY 4.0; no contrary notice was identified in the reviewed PDF. A future app projection must preserve attribution, link to the terms, indicate changes, and include necessary technical notes.
nextAction: Use the inland and marine catch categories only to prioritize searches for named La Union waterbodies and fishing grounds. Seek site-resolved surveys, specimen or occurrence records, gear/date/method details and explicit item-level reuse terms before considering any species or waterbody claim.
